mapper.select: select e.*,s.start_at,s.due_at effective_due_at,s.remind80_at,s.overdue100_at,s.escalate150_at, c.work_days,c.work_start,c.work_end,c.exception_json, p.max_extension_count,p.max_extension_value,p.max_extension_unit,p.proof_required,p.pending_sla_mode from todo_extension_request e join todo_sla_record s on s.todo_id=e.todo_id join todo_work_calendar c on c.calendar_id=s.calendar_id join todo_sla_policy_version p on p.policy_version_id=e.policy_version_id where e.todo_id=#{todoId} and e.status='PENDING' limit 1
select * from todo_template where template_id=#{templateId}

select v.*,prd.definition_package_state prd_definition_package_state,prd.foundation_state prd_foundation_state,prd.production_state prd_production_state,prd.blockers_json prd_blockers_json from todo_template_version v join todo_template t on t.template_id=v.template_id left join todo_prd_definition_catalog prd on prd.template_code=t.template_code where v.template_id=#{templateId} order by v.version_no desc
mapper.update: update todo_template_version set definition_schema_version=#{definitionSchemaVersion},definition_json=#{definitionJson},compiled_json=#{compiledJson},definition_hash=#{definitionHash},validation_report_json=#{validationReportJson},owner_rule_json=#{ownerRuleJson},dod_rule_json=#{dodRuleJson},sla_rule_json=#{slaRuleJson},next_rule_json=#{nextRuleJson},ui_schema_json=#{uiSchemaJson},change_summary=#{changeSummary},impact_scope=#{impactScope} where version_id=#{versionId} and status='DRAFT' and definition_json <=> #{expectedDefinitionJson}

update todo_template_version v join todo_template t on t.template_id=v.template_id set v.status='PUBLISHED',v.published_by=#{operator},v.published_time=sysdate(),t.current_version=greatest(t.current_version,v.version_no),t.update_by=#{operator},t.update_time=sysdate() where v.version_id=#{versionId} and v.status='DRAFT' and v.definition_hash=#{definitionHash}
mapper.select: select * from todo_definition_action where action_id=#{actionId}
mapper.update: update todo_definition_action set entity_id=#{entityId} where action_id=#{actionId} and entity_id is null
mapper.select: select * from todo_definition_action where action_id=#{actionId} for update
mapper.update: update todo_definition_action set action_status='APPLIED',entity_id=#{entityId} where action_id=#{actionId} and request_fingerprint=#{requestFingerprint} and action_status='CLAIMED' and entity_id is null
mapper.sql: exists(select 1 from todo_relation r where r.todo_id=t.todo_id and r.business_type=#{businessType} and r.business_id=#{businessId})
mapper.select: select sum(case when t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') then 1 else 0 end) active_count, sum(case when t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') and t.sla_status in ('OVERDUE','ESCALATED') then 1 else 0 end) overdue_count, min(case when t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') then t.due_at end) nearest_due_at from todo_instance t where
select distinct t.owner_id from todo_instance t where and t.owner_id is not null order by t.owner_id
select a.* from todo_action_log a join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=a.todo_id where order by a.create_time desc,a.action_log_id desc limit 1
select t.* from todo_instance t where order by t.created_at desc,t.todo_id desc
select todo_id,business_type,business_id from todo_instance where todo_id=#{rootTodoId}
select t.* from todo_instance t where (t.todo_id=#{rootTodoId} or t.root_todo_id=#{rootTodoId}) and t.business_type=#{businessType} and t.business_id=#{businessId} order by t.created_at,t.todo_id
select * from todo_exception_log where action_id=#{actionId}
mapper.update: update todo_instance set status=#{toStatus},completed_at=case when #{toStatus}='COMPLETED' then sysdate() else completed_at end,cancelled_at=case when #{toStatus}='CANCELLED' then sysdate() else cancelled_at end,version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where todo_id=#{todoId} and status=#{fromStatus} and status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')

update todo_instance set owner_id=#{ownerId},owner_dept_id=#{ownerDeptId},version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where todo_id=#{todoId} and status=#{fromStatus} and status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: select * from todo_sla_record where todo_id=#{todoId}
select * from todo_sla_waiver where action_id=#{actionId}
mapper.update: update todo_sla_record s join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=s.todo_id set s.due_at=#{newDueAt},s.remind80_at=case when s.remind80_at is null then null else s.remind80_at end,s.overdue100_at=case when s.overdue100_at is null then null else s.overdue100_at end,s.escalate150_at=case when s.escalate150_at is null then null else s.escalate150_at end,s.version=s.version+1,t.due_at=#{newDueAt},t.sla_status=case when s.overdue100_at is null then 'NORMAL' else t.sla_status end,t.version=t.version+1 where s.todo_id=#{todoId} and s.due_at=#{originalDueAt} and s.status in ('RUNNING','PAUSED')
mapper.select: select operation_type,count(*) operation_count,max(create_time) latest_time from todo_exception_log group by operation_type union all select 'SLA_WAIVER',count(*),max(create_time) from todo_sla_waiver
mapper.update: update todo_instance set status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=sysdate(),version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and todo_id<>#{exceptTodoId} and status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: select t.todo_id,t.due_at,v.compiled_json,s.remind80_due_at,s.overdue100_due_at,s.escalate150_due_at from todo_instance t join todo_template_version v on v.version_id=t.template_version_id left join todo_sla_record s on s.todo_id=t.todo_id and s.status='RUNNING' where t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') and v.status='PUBLISHED' and v.compiled_json is not null and not exists(select 1 from todo_sla_record paused where paused.todo_id=t.todo_id and paused.status='PAUSED') and (t.due_at<=#{now} or s.remind80_due_at<=#{now} or s.overdue100_due_at<=#{now} or s.escalate150_due_at<=#{now})
select * from todo_auto_action_execution where execution_key=#{executionKey}
select * from todo_auto_action_execution where execution_key=#{executionKey} for update
mapper.update: update todo_auto_action_execution set status='CLAIMED',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,claimed_at=#{now},update_time=#{now} where execution_key=#{executionKey} and status='RETRY' and attempt_count=#{expectedAttempt} and next_retry_at<=#{now}

update todo_auto_action_execution set attempt_count=attempt_count+1,claimed_at=#{now},update_time=#{now} where execution_key=#{executionKey} and status='CLAIMED' and attempt_count=#{expectedAttempt} and claimed_at<=#{staleBefore}

update todo_auto_action_execution set status='DEAD',attempt_count=#{finalAttempt},completed_at=#{now},next_retry_at=null,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=#{now} where execution_key=#{executionKey} and status='CLAIMED' and attempt_count=#{expectedAttempt} and claimed_at<=#{staleBefore} and not exists(select 1 from todo_action_log committed where committed.action_id=#{executionKey})

update todo_auto_action_execution set status=#{status},next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt},last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},completed_at=case when #{status} in ('SUCCESS','DEAD') then #{now} else null end,update_time=#{now} where execution_key=#{executionKey} and status='CLAIMED' and attempt_count=#{attemptNo}

update todo_instance set status='CREATED',owner_id=null,owner_dept_id=null,claimed_at=null,started_at=null,submitted_at=null,version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where todo_id=#{todoId} and status=#{fromStatus} and status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
